## Objective
- Expand RIFT//CLASH with 15 selectable Mortal Kombat and Street Fighter characters, show their names in the title screen and HUD, and add more visual detail to the fighters.

## Requirements
- Include 15 randomly selected characters drawn from both franchises.
- Make fighter choices selectable and visible to players.

## Decisions
- Use title-screen selection: Q/E cycles the player, A/D cycles the CPU; Enter starts the fight.
- Show selected fighter names on the title screen and above each fighter’s HUD.
- Add distinct appearance details for each character.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added a randomized 15-character roster split between Mortal Kombat and Street Fighter.
- Added keyboard title-screen selection, visible selected names, and fighter names in the HUD.
- Added pointer-based selection on the title canvas.

### Active
- Integrate the newly added per-character appearance data into fighter rendering so the fighters look distinct.
- Validate selection, gameplay, round resets, and script syntax.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Inspect `index.html` and connect `characterLooks` to `drawFighter`; the existing renderer still uses generic palettes.
2. Extract the inline script and run `node --check`.
3. Test character selection, starting/rematching, and name/appearance updates in the HUD and gameplay.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game code, roster, character selection, per-character appearance data, renderer, and HUD.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- `characterLooks` was added with distinct color and feature data for all 30 roster characters, but is not yet used by `drawFighter`.
- The mobile title-screen pointer selection chooses fighters by tapping the left/right canvas areas; touch-control buttons no longer auto-start the fight.
